title: The low-temperature Sherrington–Kirkpatrick fluctuation scale

abstractEnglish: For the zero-field Gaussian Sherrington–Kirkpatrick model at every fixed inverse temperature β > 1, we prove that the standard deviation of the log partition function is $`n^{1/6+o(1)}`$. The same exponent describes its typical centered absolute fluctuations, establishing the predicted one-sixth exponent in this regime.
